description: Interactive themes × quarters product roadmap. Auto-discovers lane sections + initiative articles; editable mode adds pointer and keyboard rescheduling, resizing, and lane moves.

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: First date in the range (ISO 8601 or "YYYY-Qn"; required)

attributes.name: end
attributes.description: Last date in the range (ISO 8601 or "YYYY-Qn"; required, inclusive)

attributes.name: editable
attributes.description: Enable editing: drag a bar (or press ←/→) to reschedule, drag its right edge (or Shift+←/→) to resize, drag onto another lane (or Alt+↑/↓) to move it

attributes.name: today-marker
attributes.description: Render a vertical line at today's date if it falls within the range

structure.description: One per initiative bar inside a lane (data-status sets the bar colour and status label)

childAttributes.name: data-lane
childAttributes.description: Lane name (used as the row label)

childAttributes.name: data-start
childAttributes.description: Initiative start date (ISO 8601 or YYYY-Qn → first day of the quarter)

childAttributes.name: data-end
childAttributes.description: Initiative end date, inclusive (ISO 8601 or YYYY-Qn → last day of the quarter). Equal to data-start for a one-day initiative

childAttributes.name: data-status
childAttributes.description: Status enum; drives the bar colour and a visible status label (custom values are shown as text with the default colour)

events.name: product-roadmap:select
events.description: Fired when a bar is clicked or activated with Enter/Space. start/end are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD

events.name: product-roadmap:reschedule
events.description: Fired when a drag along the time axis (or ←/→ in editable mode) changes the dates. Both ends snap to the nearest period boundary; end is inclusive (e.g. 2027-03-31). Not fired when a drag snaps back to the same dates

events.name: product-roadmap:resize
events.description: Fired when dragging the right edge (or Shift+←/→) changes the end date; the end snaps to the last day of the nearest period, never shorter than one period

events.name: product-roadmap:move
events.description: Fired when a bar is dropped on a different lane (pointer drag or Alt+↑/↓). The source <article> is moved into the target <section data-lane>. If the drag also changed the dates, reschedule fires first
